entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of compact bionic module 'Exodii Cyberframe 1b'
identity: A very human-like Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, will be encased in a frame that resembles a robotic human.  The frame increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is modestly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature and feel pain.  Internal bleeding can still occur with sufficient damage.
